name: Greater Mark Of Passage
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Passage Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Intuitive Motion benefit of your Mark of Passage feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Inspired Passage
features.description: When you use the Magical Passage benefit of your Mark of Passage feat to cast Misty Step without a spell slot, you can also choose up to two willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself before you teleport. Each target can then take a Reaction to also teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
